title: Minimum evidence requirements for an in-play residual-correction claim (match-level)
unit_of_independence: international match (all snapshots of a match form one cluster)

minimum_matches_by_effect_size.verdict: ALREADY detectable at 58 matches if it existed; the eval found no such effect

is_58_enough.answer: no for the uplift that matters
is_58_enough.detail: 58 matches has ~90% power only for a LARGE 0.0100 absolute RPS improvement. For the realistic small in-play corrections actually tested (best candidate was 0.0049 WORSE than reference), 58 matches has 10-28% power for 0.0005-0.0030 improvements. A null result at 58 matches cannot distinguish 'no edge' from 'small real edge we cannot see'. The eval correctly returned reference_only / no acceptance, not a positive claim.

matches_for_credible_claim.answer: ~150 independent international matches for a moderate 0.0050 RPS edge at 80% power; ~400 for a 0.0030 edge; ~1000 for a 0.0020 edge
matches_for_credible_claim.smallest_practical_threshold: 150 international matches (~13 tournaments) is the smallest grid point reaching 80% power for any plausibly-real effect (0.0050).
matches_for_credible_claim.caveat: These assume the true effect equals the target; smaller true effects need far more matches and may be economically out of reach.

more_snapshots_without_more_matches.detail: Power at 58 matches is ~flat (0.27-0.30) across 1x/2x/4x/8x snapshot inflation at delta=0.0030. The independent unit is the match; extra snapshots of the same matches are within-cluster and do not add independent information. Densifying snapshots on the existing 58 matches is NOT a path to a credible claim.

acceptance_protocol_recommendation.decision_rule: match-level paired cluster bootstrap, candidate accepted iff two-sided 95% CI on mean(candidate-reference) RPS lies entirely below 0 AND calibration_ok AND fold majority
forbidden: club matches substituted for international without a separate club power curve
acceptance_protocol_recommendation.note: This is a research evidence threshold, not a runtime/trade approval. All artifacts remain research_only/not_runtime_approved/not_trade_eligible/not_live_eligible.

club_only_lever.reason: the residual eval contained zero club matches (club_transfer_active=false); no club per-match RPS exists to estimate a club-only power curve. Club football has far higher annual match volume and could reach 150+ matches quickly, but transfer to international in-play dynamics is unproven and would need its own validation.
